editionLabel: Split Stone Games English strategic mushroom game, 2024
firstPlayerRule: The person who most recently saw a mushroom in the wild starts. Alternatively, draw one spore from each player from a hat and use the first one drawn.
clarifications: Before play, place Mother mushrooms in reverse turn order.
This is the Split Stone Games strategy title BGG 378476, separate from Ravensburger’s deck-building game of the same name.

internalEvidence: Downloaded and rendered the Split Stone Games English publisher-produced rulebook from an archive. PDF page 3 is a printed-page 4–5 spread; printed page 5 gives the recent wild-mushroom criterion, spore-draw alternative and reverse-order Mother mushroom setup. PDF page 4 gives clockwise ordinary turns. Mushroom cards, spore counters and Mother mushrooms establish the distinct BGG 378476 identity. uncertainty: The rules do not give a tie procedure for equally recent wild-mushroom sightings; their humorous suggestion to argue for 15 minutes is not presented as a formal tie-break.
